summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $5B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C (exp 2026-12-18) and significant $1.6B+ bets on SPX 7000C (exp 2027-12-17). While intraday SPX/SPXW shows high Put buying ($3.4B), the multi-day persistent flow confirms a massive, structural long-term call strategy centered around the 7000 strike. Notable conviction is also seen in aggressive single-day accumulations for SNDK 800C ($331.3M) and NVDA 180C ($301.1M), alongside extreme bullishness in INTC (0.10 P/C). Traders should watch for volatility in SPX as the market balances heavy short-term put buying against these massive, multi-session long-dated call positions.
